evidence.note: AdvChain trains large reasoning models with adversarial chain-of-thought examples (Temptation-Correction and Hesitation-Correction pairs) to teach dynamic self-correction, reducing a 'snowball effect' where small reasoning deviations compound into harmful compliance or excessive refusal.
evidence.title: AdvChain: Adversarial Chain-of-Thought Tuning for Robust Safety Alignment of Large Reasoning Models
